improved: Windows player component is now always rebuilt when its code changes, so installers never ship an outdated player.

new: Watch Party from the latest upstream Nuvio: watch together in sync with friends (experimental).
MDBList dynamic and liked lists in the library.
improved: Updated to the latest upstream Nuvio Desktop, with a buffer bar in the player and the updated p2p streaming engine (0.1.5).
Skip buttons and Good / Wrong work in a Watch Party: a skip follows the party's control rules and is shared with the party.
fixed: Player panel header buttons and rail panels stay in place.
Clearer error when the native player fails to load.

new: Good / Wrong after Skip: about 4 seconds after a skip lands, Nuvio asks if it was right, for 8 seconds. Good saves the times as your own mark and sends them to TheIntroDB. Wrong gives you Rewind 5s and End is here to fix the end.
Your own skip marks always win over TheIntroDB, IntroDB and the anime sources for that episode or movie.
Your earlier TheIntroDB submissions are imported as your own marks when you play a title with your TheIntroDB key set. The last import shows in Playback settings.
Skip Recap and Skip Preview buttons, for movies too.
improved: The Skip button shows the segment's times and where they came from, like "Skip Intro 1:12–2:41 · TheIntroDB".
Submit Timestamps fills in each segment type's own known times when you switch type, and what you submit is saved as your own mark.
Downloads show speed and time left while downloading, a check on watched items, a progress bar for part-watched ones, and which skip times are your own marks.

new: This What's new screen. It shows once after each update, and you can open it again from Settings > About.
Submit Timestamps: mark intro, recap, credits and preview times from the player and send them to TheIntroDB and IntroDB.
TheIntroDB support: skip times for intros, recaps, credits and previews come from theintrodb.org.
Auto Sync lines up subtitles with the audio by itself.
Hold to speed now works on Desktop: hold to play faster, let go to go back to normal speed.
improved: Submit Timestamps shows times as H:MM:SS with the episode length, and greys out types you already sent in this session.
Your IntroDB and TheIntroDB API keys are masked in Settings.
Streams start faster with a smaller buffer, and dropped streams reconnect by themselves.
Picture in Picture on macOS: move and resize the window, controls show once it settles, and the paused frame stays visible.
TorBox cloud libraries load even when they are very large.
The image cache has a size limit, so Nuvio uses less disk and memory over time.
Libraries on your media servers that mix movies and shows now open and sync.
Updated to the latest upstream Nuvio Desktop (0.1.30-alpha).
What's new loads the latest notes from GitHub Releases when online, is cached for offline use, and falls back to the built-in notes. It never delays launch.
fixed: Windows: no more flicker or high frame rate while nothing is playing.
Player files are no longer read into memory at launch.
The list scrollbar stays steady while scrolling.
Full screen trailers no longer trap you in full screen.
Next episode no longer starts by an accidental click.
